snippet.title: ANNOUNCEMENT - Too Hot to Hold (Multiplayer Party Game of Hot Potato With Guns & Proximity Chat)
snippet.description:
Too Hot to Hold is an up-to-10-player asymmetric party game of hot potato with proximity voice chat, wild abilities, dirty traps, and armed Wardens.

🔥 Wishlist Too Hot to Hold on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5199210/Too_Hot_To_Hold/

Grab the burning Ember and run! Tricksters can only hold it for 10 seconds before it explodes, forcing players to pass it, throw it, or dump it on someone else. Meanwhile, armed Wardens hunt them down and try to shoot the Ember apart before the timer runs out.

Expect:

• Up to 10-player online multiplayer
• Asymmetric PvP — Tricksters vs. Wardens
• Proximity voice chat
• Wild abilities, traps, gadgets, and movement tools
• Giant hand-painted environments
• Randomized map gadgets
• Unlockable cosmetics and titles
• Multiple game modes, including Hot Potato, Infiltration, and Mole / Impostor

📅 Coming November 3, 2026

Developed by MystiveDev, creators of Mirror Forge, Chasmal Fear, and Saint of Chains.

#TooHotToHold #IndieGame #PartyGame #MultiplayerGame #SteamGame #ProximityChat #IndieGames
